propositions: criterion_prompt_id hardcodes plan-review prompt prefix unconditionally, causing code-review criteria to resolve into the plan-review namespace instead of the code-review namespace
The resolver must accept a gate_key parameter (defaulting to 'plan_review') to select the correct prompt prefix ('plan-review-' or 'code-review-') without breaking existing callers
Unknown gate_key values must raise CriteriaError to fail fast on invalid gate specifications
Criterion IDs must remain filesystem-safe and injective across gates after namespace rewriting (project.foo + code_review → code-review-project-foo)
Default behavior (gate_key='plan_review') must preserve existing plan-review parity byte-for-byte, requiring no changes to current call sites
